description.fun: A snail made of dead leaves whose real body is its shell: a coil of wooden writing tablets, brought to life by the grudge of someone punished long ago for writing down a king's evil deeds. It drains the life from plants around it, turning whole forests and fields barren in an instant. Its shell is modelled on the bamboo and wooden slips used for writing in China before paper.
description.guide: A Dark and Grass-type Legendary Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, one of the four treasures of ruin. Its true form is the row of wooden tablets that makes up its shell, and it withers the plants around it. It is known as the Tablets of Ruin.
description.tagline: A dead-leaf snail around tablets recording a king's evil deeds
